title: Correct period expression
description: Essential: The student must state the period as T = t/n.

title: Correct height expression
description: Essential: The student must derive and state the height as h = cube_root(G M t^2/(4 n^2 π^2)) - R.

title: Correct velocity expression
description: Essential: The student must derive and state the linear velocity as v = cube_root(2 π G M n / t).

title: Apply Newton's law correctly
description: Important: The student must set gravitational force equal to centripetal force: G M m / (R+h)^2 = m (4π^2 / T^2)(R+h).

title: Solve for orbital radius
description: Important: The student must correctly solve the force equation to find the orbital radius (R+h) = cube_root(G M T^2 / (4π^2)).

title: Relate velocity to period
description: Important: The student must use the circular motion relation v = 2π(R+h)/T or its equivalent.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The student shows clear algebraic steps to derive the final expressions for h and v.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student verifies or mentions the dimensional consistency of the final answers.

title: Incorrect centripetal acceleration
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for centripetal force/acceleration (e.g., m v^2 / h or m ω^2 R).

title: Sign or substitution error
description: Pitfall: Making an algebraic sign error or incorrectly substituting T = t/n into the derived equations.
